description: Reference corpus of known behaviour shapes. Used as a novelty baseline: a sequence that matches a known shape is not novel, it is expected. Matching is structural (delta shapes, ordering, detector signals), never on function names alone.

delta_shapes.description: Two operations whose normalized state deltas cancel exactly (deposit/withdraw, mint/burn, borrow/repay).
Deltas cancel on some but not all shared accounting variables.
Assets and shares move together by the same amount: the ordinary 1:1 vault path.
Balances are debited and credited within the same variable, netting to zero.
A nonce or counter incremented by a constant.

weaknesses.description: Control leaves the contract before the state update that the guard depends on.
An unguarded entry point writes authority-bearing state.
Share conversion divides by a supply an early depositor can skew.
Accounting consumes a spot price that is movable inside one transaction.
Recorded amount and received amount can diverge when the asset takes a fee on transfer.
